label: 3. Hey, are you good at swimming?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Hey, are you good at swimming?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It's kind of embarrassing to say out loud,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: but I'm an excellent swimmer.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: When you put me in water, I'm like a fish.
What makes you ask?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Folkwang was eyeballing me

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: when I was practicing at the swimming pool.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: After a while,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: she challenged me to a swimming race.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Apparently, she's pretty competitive.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I was getting a little bored swimming on my own,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: so I wanted to test my skills.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I could prove what Aegis is capable of

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: and why we are the Navy.
Sounds like you were excited.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Of course, I was!

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Nikkes can't typically swim,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: so a swimming competition isn't something you see every day.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: What's wrong?
Does that mean Folkwang can't swim either?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Oh, that...

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Well, Folkwang decided to run on water.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Since she's a track athlete, it should probably work for her?
No kidding.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Anyway, come watch if you have time.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It'll be fun.
I'll make sure not to miss it.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: All right, I'm off to practice.
I'm sure the competition will be an exhilarating one in numerous ways...
